subject.title: Skills silently truncated - user-created skills invisible with no warning or prioritization

question: Should OpenClaw resolve this issue first with the narrow omitted-key visibility fix, a new priority/pinning config surface, broader smart/lazy skill indexing, or a staged combination?
rationale: The source-level truncation behavior is real, but several proposed remedies change prompt policy and possibly the skills config contract, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Stage Narrow Visibility First
options.body: Land or repair the omitted-key recovery path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/42637, then evaluate priority and smart loading separately.

options.title: Design Priority/Pinning First
options.body: Hold the narrow fix until maintainers choose a durable `skills.entries` or per-context required-skills contract.

options.title: Fold Into Smart Skill Indexing
options.body: Treat this issue as part of the broader lazy-loading/indexing design tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89361.

recommendation.title: Stage Narrow Visibility First
recommendation.body: Land or repair the omitted-key recovery path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/42637, then evaluate priority and smart loading separately.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest current-main owner signal for the moved skills loading/docs surface and participated in adjacent maintainer takeover proof.
